BEGIN;

LOCK TABLE practice_learning_readiness_receipt IN ACCESS EXCLUSIVE MODE;
DO $$ BEGIN
    IF EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM practice_learning_readiness_receipt) THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION 'cannot remove practice_learning_readiness_receipt while readiness evidence exists';
    END IF;
END $$;

DROP TRIGGER trg_protect_practice_learning_readiness_receipt ON practice_learning_readiness_receipt;
DROP FUNCTION protect_practice_learning_readiness_receipt();
DROP TABLE practice_learning_readiness_receipt;

COMMIT;
